title: Scalable decision-making for games of imperfect information
title_zh: 针对不完全信息游戏的可扩展决策制定
abstract: Abstract Real-world decision-making generally involves hidden information, that is, information that is unknown to one agent but possessed by another. Unfortunately, the presence of large amounts of hidden information renders established reinforcement learning and search approaches ineffective. Even with multimillion-dollar industrial research efforts 1 , top-human-level play at Stratego—a board wargame with hidden information on a massive scale—has remained beyond the reach of artificial intelligence (AI). Here we introduce Ataraxos, an AI for Stratego based on general techniques that we developed for both self-play reinforcement learning and test-time search under hidden information. Ataraxos defeated the most decorated human Stratego player of all time by a large margin—achieving, to our knowledge, the first superhuman result in the game’s history—while consuming orders of magnitude less compute and data than previous efforts. Using the same techniques, we built a superhuman AI for Barrage Stratego and state-of-the-art AIs for Hanabi and dou dizhu , all with low cost and high sample efficiency. The success of this approach across adversarial, cooperative and team games establishes a design pattern for reinforcement learning and search that is effective under large amounts of hidden information, a longstanding desideratum of the field of strategic decision-making.
abstract_zh: 摘要：现实世界的决策通常涉及隐藏信息，即某一代理未知但另一代理已知的信息。不幸的是，隐藏信息的巨大量使得现有的强化学习和搜索方法失效。即使在数百万美元的工业研究投入下，具有大规模隐藏信息的棋盘战争游戏《Stratego》的顶级人类水平玩法仍未被人工智能（AI）突破。在此，我们介绍了 Ataraxos，一种基于我们为自我对弈强化学习和测试时隐藏信息搜索开发的通用技术的《Stratego》AI。Ataraxos 以显著优势击败了史上最具荣誉的《Stratego》人类选手，创下了该游戏历史上首个超人类成绩，同时所需计算量和数据量比以往工作低了数个数量级。利用相同技术，我们还构建了《Barrage Stratego》的超人类 AI，以及《Hanabi》和《斗地主》的最先进 AI，均具备低成本和高样本效率。该方法在对抗、合作和团队游戏中的成功，确立了一种在大量隐藏信息下有效的强化学习与搜索设计模式，满足了战略决策领域长期以来的需求。
